    right = max(c for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] == 5)
    for r in range(top + 1, bottom):

            d = min(r - top - 1, bottom - 1 - r, c - left - 1, right - 1 - c)

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
